body: As I slowly approach the note, I notice the faint handwriting on it, an unfamiliar script that sends a shiver down my spine. The words "we need to talk" seem to leer at me, a mysterious invitation to a private conversation. My curiosity is piqued, and I wonder what could be the subject of this meeting.
